crossRefs.note: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

translations.web: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.
translations.bsb: The lot for the South Gate fell to Obed-edom, and the lot for the storehouses to his sons.
translations.kjv: To Obededom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
translations.asv: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the store-house.
